law: FROZEN RECIPE (GATE 1A.2 sections 4 and 9). InstanceInitiatedShutdownBehavior is terminate, so an OS shutdown IS termination; IMDSv2 is required so instance identity is verifiable; the instance type is the signed g5.xlarge. Launched only under a verified EXECUTION approval; never in Gate 1A.2.
note: AMI id, key pair, security group, and IAM instance profile are owner-account values resolved at launch under the signed approval; they are identity-checked on-instance (exec/identity.py) and recorded in the campaign receipt.
